title: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.34799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies are often trained by mixing contradictory feedback that is localized in space and time. For example, a robot may prioritize speed in open areas versus precision in tight gaps. We introduce Split-RL, a Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) algorithm that uses guidance labels to locally isolate these conflicting signals. Standard neural networks (NNs) lack the structural mechanism to do this, as their parameters share feedback from all sources. While GBT provides the inductive bias to explicitly partition the state-space per objective, standard tree-fitting procedures aggregate contradictory gradient signals before they reach the leaves. Split-RL leverages this bias to integrate guidance labels into tree construction, routing these updates into disjoint state-space regions and preventing signal interference. translated_title: Split-RL：强化学习中的局部冲突消解
translated_abstract: 强化学习策略的训练过程通常会混合在空间和时间上局部化的矛盾反馈。例如，机器人在开阔区域可能优先考虑速度，而在狭窄缝隙中则优先考虑精度。我们提出了Split-RL，这是一种基于梯度提升树（GBT）的算法，它利用引导标签在局部隔离这些冲突信号。标准神经网络缺乏实现这一目标的结构机制，因为其参数共享来自所有来源的反馈。虽然GBT提供了为每个目标显式划分状态空间的归纳偏置，但标准的树拟合过程会在矛盾梯度信号到达叶子节点之前将其聚合。Split-RL利用这一偏置，将引导标签集成到树构建过程中，将这些更新路由到互不相交的状态空间区域，从而防止信号干扰。此类标签可以来自启发式方法、传感器事件或现有的基于规则的系统。
tldr: Split-RL是一种基于梯度提升树的强化学习算法，通过将引导标签集成到树构建中，把矛盾反馈路由到互不相交的状态空间区域，实现冲突信号的局部隔离并防止信号干扰。
en_tdlr: Split-RL is a Gradient Boosting Trees-based RL algorithm that integrates guidance labels into tree construction, routing conflicting feedback into disjoint state-space regions to achieve local conflict isolation and prevent signal interference.
